about.title: We help families eat well and stay well.
about.intro: Living Dose brings healthy food, personal nutrition and care from experts together, at prices that make sense for real households.
story: Many families live with conditions like diabetes and high blood pressure that better food and earlier care could help prevent. Yet healthy food can be hard to find, advice is often generic, and seeing an expert can feel out of reach.

Living Dose puts the pieces in one place: foods you already know, plans built around your health and your budget, and experts a tap away. We work directly with local farmers, so good food costs less and reaches you fresher.
about.mission: To bring affordable healthy food, nutrition support and preventive care to every household, using technology, local food systems and the power of community.
about.vision: A world where every family, whatever it earns and wherever it lives, can eat well, understand its health and get care before illness starts.
